BestAquariums

The public aquariums worth a detour — the vast ocean halls built around whale sharks and open-water tanks, and the smaller institutions doing the serious breeding and conservation work. Feeding and diver-talk times are usually the difference between a good visit and a great one, and they are published daily rather than fixed.

SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium
Darling Harbour, Sydney
Great Barrier Reef Species
A major public aquarium on Sydney's waterfront, known for its underwater tunnels and dugongs, showcasing marine life drawn largely from Australian waters including the Great Barrier Reef.
Wikipedia Official Sydney Guide Map
AquaRio
Porto Maravilha, Rio de Janeiro
Largest in South America12m Acrylic Tunnel
Opened as part of Rio's waterfront regeneration for the 2016 Olympics, it is the largest aquarium in South America, centered on a 12-meter acrylic tunnel with sharks, rays, and open-ocean species.
Wikipedia Map
Oceanário de Aracaju
Orla de Atalaia, Aracaju
Run with Projeto TAMAR
A coastal aquarium on the Atalaia beachfront run in partnership with Projeto TAMAR, Brazil’s national sea-turtle programme, with tanks covering the reef, mangrove and open-ocean habitats of the Sergipe coast.
Aracaju Guide Projeto TAMAR Map
Ripley's Aquarium of Canada
Downtown Toronto (beside the CN Tower)
A large downtown aquarium next to the CN Tower whose signature attraction is a long moving walkway that carries visitors through a tunnel surrounded by sharks and other predators.
Wikipedia Official Toronto Guide Map
Vancouver Aquarium
Stanley Park, Vancouver
One of Canada's Oldest AquariumsMarine Research Center
Located in Stanley Park, this is one of Canada's oldest and largest aquariums, long recognized as a center for marine research, conservation, and public education about ocean life.
Wikipedia Official Vancouver Guide Map
Chimelong Ocean Kingdom
Hengqin, Zhuhai, Guangdong
Guinness World Record: Largest AquariumLargest Aquarium Window
Part of a vast marine theme park in southern China, this aquarium holds several Guinness World Records for scale and is famed for its enormous whale shark tank.

Shanghai Ocean Aquarium
Pudong, Shanghai
One of World's Longest Underwater Tunnels
Set in the Pudong district near the Oriental Pearl Tower, it is organized around regional zones and features one of the world's longest underwater viewing tunnels.

Den Blå Planet
Kastrup, Copenhagen
Denmark's National AquariumNear Copenhagen Airport
Denmark's national aquarium, whose distinctive whirlpool-shaped building near Copenhagen's airport houses freshwater and marine exhibits ranging from Amazon rivers to open-ocean tanks.

Nausicaá
Boulogne-sur-Mer, Hauts-de-France
National Sea Center
A national sea center on France's Channel coast dedicated to raising awareness of the oceans, built around vast tanks that recreate open-water and coral reef environments.

Ozeaneum
Old Town Harbour, Stralsund
2010 European Museum of the Year
A critically acclaimed natural history of the sea museum on the Baltic coast, winner of the 2010 European Museum of the Year Award, known for its dramatic architecture and large open-ocean tanks focused on North Atlantic and Baltic marine life.

Acquario di Genova
Old Port, Genoa
Designed by Renzo PianoOne of Europe's Largest
A centerpiece of Genoa's redeveloped Old Port, designed by Renzo Piano, it is one of Europe's largest aquariums and a leading draw for visitors to the Italian Riviera city.

Giant Kuroshio TankWhale Sharks & Manta Rays
Set within Ocean Expo Park in northern Okinawa, it is renowned for its huge Kuroshio tank, one of the largest in the world, home to whale sharks and manta rays.

Tempozan Harbour Village, Osaka
One of Japan's LargestCentral Pacific Ocean Tank

One of Southeast Asia's Longest Underwater Tunnels

Built in Former Sewage TanksAntarctic Penguin Exhibit

SEA LIFE London Aquarium
County Hall, South Bank, London

Georgia Aquarium
Atlanta, Georgia

Rooftop Rainforest
